protocol: 48 men and four altitude settings from 22,500 to 30,000 ft. One hour of oxygen prebreathe, periodic exercise and precordial Doppler every 15 minutes.
outcome_window: During chamber exposure scheduled for up to 8 hours. Grade 2 limb bends could trigger descent.
note: The abstract gives 126 flights with limb bends and 64 without. Grade 2 was constant moderate pain that resolved on descent.
